luna_findings.source_quote: He pulled a warrant form toward him.
luna_findings.why: The translation changes the document from a warrant form he is about to fill out into an already existing authorization document.

luna_findings.source_quote: The control stone, checked between each reading, stayed dark and silent both times.
luna_findings.translation_quote: Her okuma arasında kontrol edilen kontrol taşı, her iki seferde de karanlık ve sessiz kaldı.
luna_findings.why: The source says the control stone stayed dark and silent on both intervening checks; the translation makes it sound as though there were only two readings/checks, obscuring the three-reading sequence.

luna_findings.source_quote: He was just back — travel cloak still over the chair, the assembly's dust on his boots.
luna_findings.translation_quote: Henüz dönmüştü; seyahat pelerini hâlâ sandalyenin üzerindeydi, çizmelerinde meclisin tozu vardı.
luna_findings.why: The source explicitly identifies the dust as coming from the assembly; the translation's 'meclisin tozu' can mean the assembly's dust but is semantically awkward and shifts the concrete travel evidence toward an institution-associated substance.
